intent: Repair the PR CI-health control plane so scheduled rebases never rewrite a PR head with the default GITHUB_TOKEN, exact-head zero-run/draft/unknown/hard-failure states cannot be reported green, and every automated mutation remains fail-closed and human-merge-gated.

negative_controls.name: startup-failure-removal-restores-false-green
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import importlib.util,sys; p=Path('scripts/governance/pr_ci_health.py'); t=p.read_text(); old='            \"startup_failure\",\\n'; assert old in t; p.write_text(t.replace(old,'',1)); spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pr_ci_health_mutant',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[spec.name]=m; spec.loader.exec_module(m); pr={'number':1083,'title':'mutant','base':{'ref':'main'},'head':{'ref':'mutant','sha':'deadbeef'},'draft':False,'user':{'login':'tester'},'mergeable_state':'clean'}; runs=[{'name':'passing advisory','conclusion':'success'},{'name':'required gate','conclusion':'startup_failure'}]; sys.exit(1 if m.classify_pr(pr,runs).categories==['green'] else 0)"

commit.message: fix(ci-health): fail closed on bot-rebase CI stranding

interface_mismatches: The hourly PR-health workflow could rewrite exact PR heads with GITHUB_TOKEN while its classifier interpreted the resulting absence of CI evidence as green.
honest_blockers: This Session Entry packet was added after implementation because exact-head CI correctly rejected the high-risk event for having no packet; it supplies committed-range scope and does not rewrite history into a pre-edit admission claim.
PR_CI_HEALTH_PUSH_TOKEN is an operator-managed repository secret and is not provisioned or exposed by this packet; until it exists, scheduled auto-rebase remains intentionally disabled.
Already-stranded pull-request heads require separate trusted push events after this repair lands; this packet does not mutate unrelated branches.
Hosted exact-head CI, independent review policy, and human merge authority remain required.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the workflow, classifier, tests, and this packet together. Do not selectively restore GITHUB_TOKEN rebase pushes or absence-based green classification.
